items.name: Story books
items.longDescription: James really enjoys story books. Please buy books that he would enjoy being read, or that you would enjoy reading to him. They don't need to be educational - fun is absolutely fine! Picture books, silly stories, adventure tales - all welcome. We already have loads, so perhaps check with us before you buy!

items.name: Small buoyancy aid for swimming
items.longDescription: It's entirely possible that James use this for a while, but he'd like it so he can one day go near water and on boats.

items.name: Grapes or plums
items.longDescription: James loves grapes and plums! Perfect for stockings or as a healthy snack gift.

items.name: The Great British Colouring Book
items.shortDescription: A special colouring book created by top British cartoonists
items.longDescription: Created by over 50 cartoonists including Terry Gilliam and Quentin Blake, this book features more than 100 original cartoons showing different aspects of British culture. While it might be for when he's a bit older, it's a meaningful gift with a great story behind it - originally created for children arriving in the UK.

items.name: Little table with two chairs
items.shortDescription: A small table and chairs set for James
items.longDescription: A little table with two chairs - wood preferred. Second hand in good condition is perfect!

items.name: Fun eggcups
items.shortDescription: Must not be breakable - must bounce if dropped!
items.longDescription: James loves his chick eggcups! Looking for fun, colourful eggcups that are unbreakable - they must bounce if dropped. No ceramic or glass please!

items.name: Baby dolly
items.shortDescription: A doll for James to care for
items.longDescription: James would love a baby doll to look after. Second hand in good condition is absolutely fine!

items.name: Dolly toys - potty and bed
items.shortDescription: Accessories for looking after the dolly
items.longDescription: Toys for the baby dolly - things like a potty and a bed for the dolly to sleep in. Second hand is fine!

items.name: Contribution towards neoprene caving undersuit
items.longDescription: A neoprene caving undersuit for James for staying warm underground. Total cost £28 - any contributions towards this would be appreciated!

items.name: Play mat
items.shortDescription: A soft play mat for James
items.longDescription: A play mat for James to play on. Second hand in good condition is fine!

items.name: Magnetic tiles (Magna-Tiles)
items.longDescription: Magnetic building tiles like Magna-Tiles for creative play. Great for building and learning!

items.name: Contributions towards swimming lessons
items.longDescription: James is learning to swim! Swimming lessons cost £27 per month - any contributions towards this would be appreciated.

notes.checkFirst: Feel free to check with Tim and Jen if you have questions.
